frequency_question: How often does the central government successfully notify final rules within a court-mandated window of one month or less?
membership_rule: Includes all instances where a supreme judicial body issued a direct mandamus or strict deadline (30 days or less) to a central government department to notify subordinate legislation or final policy rules. Excludes general advisory guidelines or extensions granted without strict compliance oversight.

cases.name: Delhi Air Quality Commission notification deadline 2021

coverage_note: 5 named benchmark cases from recent judicial enforcement history; believed representative of central bureaucratic compliance under active judicial monitoring.
known_gaps: Does not account for specific bureaucratic resistance in health-related food policies versus environmental or financial sectors.
validity_reason: Bureaucratic compliance rates with judicial deadlines remain stable across administrative cycles unless major judicial reforms occur.
